name: Night Tide - A ZoSan Fan Visual Novel
source:
On the advice of Robin, Sanji decides to start having a nighty drink with Zoro on the deck of the ship. Surprisingly, a deeper friendship starts blossoming between the two of them-- but Sanji hesitates when he notices Zoro wanting to take the next step...

[From [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/night-tide]itch.io[/url]]
